items.Sentence: Treatment at the Valencia WRP consists of influent screening, primary sedimentation, primary effluent equalization, activated sludge biological treatment with nitrification and denitrification, secondary sedimentation, inert media filtration, disinfection (UV and/or chloramination), and dechlorination (as needed).

Hypochlorite and ammonia are still used to disinfect treated effluent at the Valencia WRP prior to discharging the effluent to the Santa Clara River.
Prior to discharge, sulfur dioxide and/or sodium bisulfite is added to the treated effluent to remove residual chlorine.
Waste activated sludge from both the Saugus and Valencia WRPs is thickened by dissolved air flotation.
